label: Every existent at w is CONCRETE_6, from contract and calibration (inference)
rule: Existence to act as to being, then esse in re to concreteness
meaning: Let x exist at w. By the existence-to-act contract x is in act as to being; by the CONCRETE_6 calibration what has esse in re is concrete; so x is concrete. No causal premise is used. Each premise is needed in a checked interpretation (controls 1 and 2). It refutes, conditionally on both open premises, the recorded rival that some actual concretum has an existing non-concrete cause of its esse: that rival's cause exists at w. So the Phaedo and Lewis motivations recorded for that rival must deny the existence-to-act contract or the calibration (a Form or set existing at w without esse in re), not the causal clause of the esse-cause bridge. Conditional consequence only; no premise is established.
